coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 11 ground-truth variable items (27%): comparison of ZB-2p with an ideal theoretical schedule, the ideal communication-overlap assumption, and measured pipeline bubble rate.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Substitutes 7B/70B models for the specified 14.6B architecture, varies pipeline size instead of fixing 16 stages, and varies microbatch counts instead of fixing 64. The general 2p setting does not preserve the specified fixed environment flags and memory limit of 32. Nsight profiling is included, but nsys export and custom Python/SVG processing are missing. MFU replaces samples/second/GPU throughput, and bubble-rate gaps do not measure stage-by-stage computed-versus-profiled timeline alignment. Numerous additional experimental factors depart from the controlled ground-truth design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected finding that ZB-2p achieves near-zero bubbles, generally below 1%, with minor real-execution overheads and supporting high throughput and tight timeline alignment.
